canonical_source_support.detail: Canonical profile Name { version N } is the frozen revision-4 source projection of the same app profile fact as legacy profile Name version N. Lint/profile-lock checks must treat both forms equivalently.

Canonical field name: Type modifiers is the frozen revision-4 source projection of an entity field. Existing entity lint invariants, including revision concurrencyToken and ref-owner checks, apply identically to canonical and historical unprefixed fields.
Canonical query/mutation parameters: [..] named HeaderArg remains the frozen revision-4 target form; positional query/mutation parameters remain legacy compatibility input.

shared_mismatch_dispositions.detail: Revision 4 admits only app profile facts. system/frontend/api/defaultDeployment and similar app links cannot become production reference evidence without a separately versioned contract/admission change and re-certification.
